LanguageData.Raven_Drug_Oxytocin.label: (Raven) Oxytocin
LanguageData.Raven_Drug_Oxytocin.description: A potent hormone drug that forcibly stimulates the reproductive system of the Raven race. Injecting it will immediately trigger a severe ovulation response, causing the user to lay an unfertilized Raven Spirit Egg in a very short time.\n\nSide effects: Causes extreme weakness and pain.
